perle.title: Musikland: Weltmeister Perle 26/48
perle.scope: Perle described as beginner instrument for small players; dealer reproduces manufacturer data and manufacturer identity.

rubin.title: Musikland: Weltmeister Rubin 30/60
rubin.scope: Rubin described as beginner instrument with reduced key width for children; not independent pedagogy research.

latvia.title: Latvian music-education equipment programme
latvia.scope: Official educational equipment document lists Weltmeister Rubin 30/60 among accordion purchases.

rubin_ru.title: Accordion Shop Russia: Weltmeister Rubin 30/60
rubin_ru.scope: Russian specialist seller documents 30/60 configuration and reduced keyboard scale for small hands; commercial evidence.

yamaha_u1.title: Yamaha: U Series U1
yamaha_u1.scope: U1 is positioned by Yamaha as professional upright for experienced pianists and professional musicians; not a beginner requirement.

yamaha_u1_uk.title: Yamaha UK: U Series
yamaha_u1_uk.scope: U1 described as long-standing upright standard; manufacturer claim.

kawai_k300.title: Kawai Global: K-300
kawai_k300.scope: K-300 professional upright construction and specifications.

kawai_de.title: Kawai Germany: K-300
kawai_de.scope: Kawai Germany explicitly frames K-300 for ambitious beginners, advanced pianists and music schools.

kawai_ru.title: Kawai Russia: K-300
kawai_ru.scope: Russian representative publishes K-300 specifications and current model presence; not school endorsement.

distinctions: Perle and Rubin are educational size steps, not a quality ranking.
Educational procurement of Rubin confirms institutional use, not universal recommendation.
U1 and K-300 are long-horizon upright candidates, not mandatory beginner instruments.
Russian manufacturer representation is distinct from Russian school endorsement.
